ctx.x: Catfish Row. It’s sort of, you know, people all–and here comes my father, you know and here was Chief, you know, he called him Chief. And so he was a little bit, you know, and I think he chided my mother after that for not, you know, the place not, but I mean, you know, this is where we lived. This is what, I guess, we could afford, you know. But anyway, I’m saying that to say that–I was talking about Admiral Radford, and somehow I forgot to point now.
Um, I, I really wanted to get, generally, at how your neighborhood informed your decision to become a musician.
